events.factual_description: World Music Institute presents Peni Candra Rini's Jiwa Kala with Shahzad Ismaily and Andy McGraw on Saturday, February 27, 2027 at National Sawdust, 80 North 6th Street in Brooklyn. WMI lists the show at 8:00 PM and identifies it as the NYC debut of Jiwa Kala, a one-hour multidisciplinary performance that combines experimental music, dance, shadow theatre and film and frames the climate crisis through concert, ritual and ecological reflection. WMI describes Rini as a Javanese singer, educator and composer whose practice blends Javanese Sufi poetry with contemporary music for Indonesian and Western instruments, and names McGraw and Ismaily as the onstage collaborators. National Sawdust's current performances calendar independently lists the February 27 engagement at 8:00 PM and the same three-person billing. WMI lists public tickets at $30 advance and $35 day of show, plus separate member prices. WMI lists 7:00 PM doors; a separate National Sawdust event surface encountered during research displayed a different doors time, so no doors time is normalized into the event record until the presenters reconcile it. The exact authorized AudienceView Professional ticket destination is verified. No additional performers or event-specific instruments for McGraw or Ismaily are inferred.

en.why_it_matters: Jiwa Kala gives the Rini–Ismaily–McGraw collaboration a specific theatrical and ecological frame rather than simply putting three adventurous musicians onstage together. Rini's Javanese vocal and compositional language, rooted partly in Sufi poetry, is folded into a one-hour work where experimental music, dance, shadow theatre and film operate as one environment. The New York debut makes this a particularly good moment to hear how that language expands beyond the concert format.
en.trip_verdict: If New York is already in play, actively build the Brooklyn evening around the 8 PM performance. From the DMV, I would pair it with another strong New York reason rather than make a dedicated corridor trip for this date alone.

es.why_it_matters: Jiwa Kala le da al cruce Rini–Ismaily–McGraw un marco teatral y ecológico concreto en vez de simplemente juntar a tres músicos aventureros en un escenario. El lenguaje vocal y compositivo javanés de Rini, atravesado en parte por poesía sufí, entra en una obra de una hora donde música experimental, danza, teatro de sombras y cine funcionan como un solo entorno. El debut neoyorquino vuelve ésta una ocasión especialmente buena para escuchar cómo ese lenguaje se expande más allá del formato de concierto.
es.trip_verdict: Si Nueva York ya está en juego, sí armaría activamente la noche de Brooklyn alrededor de la función de las 8. Desde el DMV, la combinaría con otra razón fuerte para subir en vez de hacer un viaje dedicado únicamente por esta fecha.
